name: Reunion of the House
oracle_text: Return any number of target creature cards with total power 10 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Exile Reunion of the House.
blocked_sentences: Return any number of target creature cards with total power 10 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

needs.what: a target-spec key `total_power: N` capping the summed power of all objects chosen for a variable-count target ("any number of target creature cards with total power 10 or less"), checked as targets are chosen and enforced as a joint constraint the way `total_mana_value` is
needs.why_existing_wont_do: target_keys offers `total_mana_value`, which caps the sum of mana values, not power; a per-card `power` selector filter caps each card individually, not the sum; and an unbounded `count` with `up_to` would let the spell return more than 10 power. The engine's only total_power sums are crew's tap_permanents cost and cost_reduction, neither of which applies to targets
